personal.researchStatement: Connecting physiological sensing, signal intelligence and hardware-aware AI to build reliable systems that work beyond the lab.
personal.bio: I develop machine-learning and signal-processing methods for physiological and wearable sensor data, with experience in surface EMG, EEG, phonocardiography and real-world sensing. My current research connects robust representations, efficient models and embedded deployment for biomedical, cyber-physical and robotic applications.
